gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads friendly and tall, its short stalks rising above a deep band of letters. But Audiowide draws every stroke at uniform pressure, tile-like and futuristic, while the body does the quiet work of reading.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-devana: Ornate and literary: Almendra Display never pinches its letters shut. Noto Sans Devanagari, with its open-curved g and compact skyline, is the modern, sans-serif counterweight that keeps that ornament in check.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Audiowide sets its futuristic letters like tiles with wide grout lines, every stroke drawn at a single weight. Noto Sans Elymaic then reads smoothly, its apertures open throughout.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates crowds its chalkboard lowercase up toward the capital line. Oswald, confident and tightly knit, packs its rows close, while the body runs on in generous round letters.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-ethiop: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display keeps its letters from ever pinching shut. Noto Sans Ethiopic follows with c terminals that hang far from the bowl on a sturdy, tall lowercase, which keeps extended reading modern and steady.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide draws every stroke with the texture of neatly bent pipe cleaner. Noto Sans Georgian takes the quieter job next to it, modern, open-curved and clean.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-julius-sans-one: Tightly knit rows are what Oswald does best. Julius Sans One does the opposite, spreading open-ended curves across big stretches of blank space, with capitals and lowercase nearly level.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Neon-tube sleek, Audiowide draws every stroke with the same glow-like consistency and tile-like spacing. Noto Sans Gothic then reads easily, with large lowercase counters and round forms like open parentheses.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads wide and clean, with stubby ascenders and descenders tucked beside a big x-height, curves matching its stems. Oswald adds the confident, tightly knit counterpoint up top.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Neutral and unfussy, Noto Sans Grantha keeps its tall little letters from ever snagging on a closed bowl. Audiowide, futuristic and steady in pressure, handles the loud part from first letter to last.
